questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Design of Sewer Systems & Sewer Appurtenances
questions.text: Compare Sewerage Systems: Separate System, Combined System, and Partially Separate System. Explain conditions under which each system is preferred in urban town planning.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Design of Sewer Systems & Sewer Appurtenances
questions.text: Explain the concept of Self-Cleansing Velocity ($0.6-0.8\,\text{m/s}$) and Non-Scouring Velocity ($2.5-3.0\,\text{m/s}$) in sewer design. Design a circular sewer running half-full at maximum flow using Manning's formula ($n = 0.013$) to serve a population of $50,000$ with per capita water supply of $150\,\text{lpcd}$ and peak factor $3.0$ at a ground slope of $1$ in $1000$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Quantity of Wastewater & Storm Water Flow Estimation
questions.text: Explain Sewer Appurtenances: (a) Manholes (Drop manhole, Deep manhole, Spacing rules), (b) Inverted Siphon (Depressed sewer across rivers/depressions), (c) Catch Basins, and (d) Stormwater Regulators (Leaping weir, Overflow weir).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Quantity of Wastewater & Storm Water Flow Estimation
questions.text: Define Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), and Theoretical Oxygen Demand (ThOD). Derive the First-Order BOD Kinetics equation: $y_t = L_0(1 - e^{-k t}) = L_0(1 - 10^{-K_D t})$. If 5-day $20^\circ\text{C}$ BOD of a wastewater is $220\,\text{mg/L}$ and deoxygenation constant $K_D = 0.1\,\text{day}^{-1}$ (base 10), calculate the Ultimate First-Stage Carbonaceous BOD ($L_0$) and 3-day BOD at $25^\circ\text{C}$ ($K_T = K_{20}\theta^{T-20}, \theta = 1.047$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Quantity of Wastewater & Storm Water Flow Estimation
questions.text: Explain the Streeter-Phelps Oxygen Sag Equation for stream self-purification: $D_t = \frac{K_1 L_0}{K_2 - K_1}(e^{-K_1 t} - e^{-K_2 t}) + D_0 e^{-K_2 t}$. Derive expressions for Critical Time ($t_c = \frac{1}{K_2 - K_1}\ln\left[\frac{K_2}{K_1}\left(1 - D_0\frac{K_2 - K_1}{K_1 L_0}\right)\right]$) and Critical Dissolved Oxygen Deficit ($D_c$). Draw the Oxygen Sag Curve showing Deoxygenation and Reaeration curves.

Draw the complete Process Flowsheet of a Modern Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant showing Screens, Grit Chamber, Primary Clarifier, Activated Sludge Aeration Tank, Secondary Clarifier, Sludge Digester, and Disinfection.

Explain Activated Sludge Process (ASP) design parameters: Food-to-Microorganism ratio ($F/M = \frac{Q S_0}{V X}$), Mean Cell Residence Time / Sludge Age ($\theta_c = \frac{V X}{Q_w X_w}$), Hydraulic Retention Time ($HRT = V/Q$), and Sludge Volume Index (SVI). What causes Sludge Bulking and Foaming in ASP?

Explain the working and biological mechanism of Standard Rate vs High Rate Trickling Filters. Explain NRC (National Research Council) formula for single-stage and two-stage trickling filter efficiencies ($\eta = \frac{100}{1 + 0.443\sqrt{\frac{W}{V F}}}$ where recirculation factor $F = \frac{1 + R/I}{(1 + 0.1 R/I)^2}$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Sludge Treatment, Anaerobic Digestion & Solid Waste Management
questions.text: Explain the biochemistry of Anaerobic Sludge Digestion: (1) Hydrolysis, (2) Acidogenesis, (3) Acetogenesis, and (4) Methanogenesis. Explain operational parameters affecting digestion (Temperature - Mesophilic $35^\circ\text{C}$ vs Thermophilic $55^\circ\text{C}$, pH $6.5-7.5$, volatile acids, biogas composition $65\%\,\text{CH}_4, 30\%\,\text{CO}_2$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Quantity of Wastewater & Storm Water Flow Estimation
questions.text: Design a Septic Tank and Soak Pit for a residential hostel accommodating 100 persons. Water consumption is $135\,\text{lpcd}$, sludge accumulation rate is $30\,\text{L/capita/year}$, and desludging interval is 2 years. Percolation rate of soil is $15\,\text{min/cm}$. Draw neat plan and cross-sectional view with inlet, outlet baffle walls, and vent pipe.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Sludge Treatment, Anaerobic Digestion & Solid Waste Management
questions.text: Explain Municipal Solid Waste Management: Generation rate, Physical/Chemical composition, Segregation at source, 3R principles (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle), Composting (Aerobic windrow vs Anaerobic Indore/Bangalore methods), and Engineered Sanitary Landfill (Liners, Leachate collection, Landfill gas extraction).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Sludge Treatment, Anaerobic Digestion & Solid Waste Management
questions.text: Design a High-Rate Anaerobic Sludge Digester for a town of population $100,000$ producing $70\,\text{g/capita/day}$ of dry suspended solids ($70\%$ volatile matter) with digestion period of $20\,\text{days}$. Calculate daily biogas production volume in $\text{m}^3/\text{day}$.
